---
name: Documentation correction
about: Report inaccurate, outdated, broken, or unclear promotional documentation
title: "[Docs]: "
labels: []
assignees: []
---

## Before reporting

- [ ] I searched the existing issues for duplicates.
- [ ] This concerns the **public promotional documentation repository**, not a private purchase or order.
- [ ] This is **not** a security vulnerability. I will follow [SECURITY.md](../../SECURITY.md) for private reporting.
- [ ] I have removed customer information, payment/order records, secrets, and other confidential data.

## Location of the problem

Link to the file, section heading, or affected URL.

## What is wrong?

Explain the incorrect, outdated, missing, inaccessible, or unclear information.

## Expected information / proposed correction

Describe what should change.

## Evidence or source

Provide public authoritative references (for example, official published storefront product or policy pages) where relevant. Do not include private business materials.

## Additional context

Attach sanitized screenshots or link-check results if helpful.

## Review notes

Indicate whether the correction concerns pricing, product availability, branding, policy, or technical architecture and therefore needs owner verification.
